public.description: Unauthenticated visitors. No account or login required.
privileges: Register a new account (client or lawyer)
Login to get a JWT token
View AI lawyer recommendations for a chat session

endpoints.description: Health check
Create a new user account
Authenticate and get JWT token
Request password reset token
Verify password reset token validity
Reset password with valid token
Get AI lawyer recommendations for a chat session
Get reviews for a specific lawyer
Test endpoint: simulate successful Stripe payment (disable in production)
Stripe webhook handler for payment events

authenticated_any.description: Any logged-in user regardless of role (client, lawyer, or admin).
privileges: Delete own account (with full cascade cleanup)
View and manage own reservations (filtered by role)
View reviews linked to own reservations

endpoints.description: Blacklist current JWT token (revoke session)
Get full profile (user + client/lawyer details + image)
Upload a new profile picture
Update basic profile fields (city, region)
Delete current profile picture
Delete account and all associated data (cascade)
List own reservations (filtered by role: client sees client reservations, lawyer sees lawyer reservations). Supports ?status= and ?limit= filters
Get single reservation (only if user is the client or lawyer on that reservation)
Update reservation (clients can cancel pending; lawyers can accept/reject/complete and change dates for pending)
Get review by reservation ID (only if user is the client who wrote it or the lawyer it was written about)

client.description: Regular users seeking legal assistance. Can chat with AI, book lawyers, and leave reviews.
privileges: Create and manage AI chat sessions
Send messages to AI assistant and receive responses
Extract legal specialty from chat and get lawyer recommendations
Create reservations with lawyers (subject to availability and lawyer's active subscription)
Edit or delete own reviews within 7-day window

endpoints.description: Create a new AI chat session
Send a message in a chat session (saves client message, calls AI, saves response and recommendations)
Get all messages in a chat session
Extract legal specialty from chat messages and trigger recommendations
Delete a chat session and all its messages
Create a new reservation with a lawyer (checks lawyer active status, active subscription, and timeslot availability)
Cancel a pending reservation (soft delete, sets status to cancelled)
Get all AI recommendations for the current client
Create a review for a completed reservation (auto-updates lawyer average rating)
Get all reviews written by the current client
Update own review (within 7-day edit window, recalculates lawyer rating)
Delete own review (within 7-day window, recalculates lawyer rating)

lawyer.description: Licensed legal professionals. Can manage their profile, handle reservations, manage subscriptions, and receive boosts and reviews.
privileges: View and update own lawyer profile (name, firm, specialties, languages, hourly_rate, location)
Purchase profile boosts to increase visibility (levels 1-5)
View all reviews received from clients

endpoints.description: Update lawyer profile (first_name, last_name, firm, license_number, specialties, languages, hourly_rate, city, region)
Create Stripe PaymentIntent for monthly subscription ($299 or $0 in test mode)
Create Stripe PaymentIntent for profile boost (requires active subscription, price = $49 * boost_level 1-5)
Get payment transaction history
Get current subscription status (active/expired/cancelled)
Create PaymentIntent for subscription renewal
Cancel active subscription (sets status to cancelled)
Get all reviews received by the lawyer
Get lawyer's reservations. Supports ?status=, ?date_from=, ?date_to=, ?limit= filters
Update reservation status or date (validates state transitions and timeslot conflicts)
Get payment history with date and type filters

admin.description: Platform administrators. Full oversight of the platform (routes still being developed).
privileges: Check and update expired subscriptions across the platform
View all reviews on the platform for moderation

endpoints.description: Check and update expired subscriptions (sets active -> expired)
Get all reviews across the platform for moderation. Supports ?limit= (max 100)

admin.note: Admin endpoints are still being developed. More admin functionality will be added.
